title: Cultural Landmarks of Paris
metadata: Famous historical monuments and cultural institutions of Paris, France.
Showcasing text pin icons, custom marker colors, image galleries, and zoom-on-select.

records.title: Eiffel Tower
records.description: Constructed from 1887 to 1889 as the centerpiece of the 1889 World's Fair, the Eiffel Tower stands 330 meters tall on the Champ de Mars.

records.title: Louvre Museum
records.description: The world's most-visited museum and a historic landmark housed in the Louvre Palace, celebrated for the Mona Lisa and Venus de Milo.

records.title: Notre-Dame Cathedral
records.description: A masterpiece of French Gothic architecture located on the Île de la Cité, renowned for its pioneering rib vaulting and flying buttresses.

records.title: Arc de Triomphe
records.description: Standing at the western end of the Champs-Élysées, honoring those who fought and died for France in the French Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars.

records.title: Sacré-Cœur Basilica
records.description: Perched at the summit of the butte Montmartre, this Roman Catholic basilica offers panoramic vistas overlooking the Parisian basin.

records.title: Musée d'Orsay
records.description: Installed in the former Gare d'Orsay railway station, holding the largest collection of Impressionist and Post-Impressionist masterpieces worldwide.

records.title: Panthéon
records.description: Located in the Latin Quarter, built originally as a church dedicated to Saint Genevieve and now serving as a secular mausoleum.
